text: On the road to the airport, the married couple Adjie and Astrid and their friends [give a ride home|trigger|saying yes to an offer] to Maya, a beautiful young woman who says she was robbed. At a secluded house her mother Dara, gracious and insistent, keeps them for dinner, and [the food is drugged|images|food, drink and drugs]. The guests wake in a cellar where Maya's brothers work with chainsaws, while the pregnant Astrid is told the drug will [bring on her labour|who_suffers|expectant parents], and old photographs hint that [this family does not age|wants|cheating death and age].
